page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the processor performance is generally modest. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% categories respectively. However, the Passmark CPU score and extended instructions tests show average performance in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests reveal a contrast: small-block cached reads are weak, whereas large-block uncached read and write operations achieve average performance. Cryptographic and database operations, including Redis SET throughput and Passmark database tests, fall into the bottom 25% performance bracket.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge offers a standard resource density suitable for legacy workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation but do not demand high-performance compute or high-speed local storage. Given the weak performance in compression, database operations, and medium-scale LLM inference, this instance is best suited for basic web serving, development environments, lightweight background tasks, and general-purpose applications with moderate resource requirements.
